about: AP Macroeconomics concept dependency map (docs/apmacro-spec.md, docs/apmacro-phase0.md): the 42 topics of the CED in order, the "Graph skills you need" topics (placed before Unit 1), and every concept with the topic that teaches it and the concepts it depends on. Built by Phase 0 from docs/apmacro-ced-map.json.

ced.edition: Course and Exam Description, effective fall 2025, unchanged for 2026-27 (6 units, 42 topics)

circularDependencies.problem: CED 1.2 links an outward shift of the PPC to economic growth, but Topic 5.6 is the growth topic.
circularDependencies.detail: The term is taught in 1.2 with the PPC (an outward shift is economic growth, from more or better resources or better technology); 5.6 stays its main topic, adding real GDP per capita as its measure, LRAS shifting right, and its sources (human and physical capital, productivity). Needs-author a-ppc-growth-words.
